answer_1.quote: Recently, there has been great success in automatic text summarization and generation.

answer_2.quote: But human evaluation is time-consuming and laborintensive, an automatic evaluation metric that cannot only save human resources but also simulate the ability of human judgement is of crucial importance.

answer_4.quote: Each document-summary pair is evaluated by three human raters in four dimensions (coherence, fluency, informativeness, and relevance).
